# A state-based asynchronous FIFO with bounded fault edits

29 October2026. This is a different constructive interface from a fixed-
source copy. It supplies causal capture/overwrite, backpressure, reusable
storage and a quantitative all-state eroder under continuing noise. It
does NOT supply an exponentially accurate single-bit acknowledgement or
a fully protected logical streaming processor. Those stronger claims are
explicitly separated below.

The enabling representation is ordinary exclusion/FIFO occupancy: EVERY
phase-bit configuration is valid queue state. There is no malformed clock
state from which a nominal reset must rescue the controller. The protocol
core is conventional asynchronous micropipeline logic, not a new claim.

## 1. Actual finite controller and ports

Choose capacity M>=1 and packet width B>=1. Store M payload words
v_0,...,v_(M-1) of B physical bits, and M+1 physical tag bits
t_0,...,t_M. There are

    N=(B+1)M+1

physical controller bits, ALL subject to noise. There are no other
persistent registers, counters, history tapes or timing phases.

The internal stage i, 1<=i<M, attempts the following update at independent
Poisson rate r_i in[1/2,2]:

    if t_(i-1)!=t_i and t_i==t_(i+1):
        (v_i,t_i) <- (v_(i-1),t_(i-1)) atomically.        (1)

The downstream tag t_(i+1) is a local acknowledgement: equality says the
downstream stage has consumed the current contents of stage i. The first
inequality says a new predecessor value is available. Payload and its tag
are captured TOGETHER; no separately timed bundled-data promise is used.

At a separate independent source clock of fixed rate r_0 in[1/2,2], an
input capture carrying an available offered word b is enabled only if
t_0==t_1. It atomically performs

    (v_0,t_0)<-(b,1-t_0).                                (2)

The input is accepted at THIS action, so the supplying module can thereafter
change its own offered word. This is an input port, not a learned-model or
stream-storage oracle. A caller's offered values and availability must be
supplied. Arbitrary attempted captures while full are rejected without
changing state. A noisy physical notification observed by an external
caller is not granted error-free; see Section5.

The output stage attempts at rate r_M in[1/2,2]:

    if t_(M-1)!=t_M:
        commit v_(M-1) to the consuming module;
        t_M<-t_(M-1) atomically.

# Reusable finite-cell coverage-to-recovery contract

The FIFO proof isolates a general, ordinary workload construction. Its
value is a checkable protocol input contract, not a claim that every
asynchronous decoder has such a potential.

Suppose a finite controller has m independent nominal Poisson attempt
clocks of fixed rates>=r_min>0 and a function W with values0,...,Wmax.
Require the following STRUCTURAL facts for its actual local transition
functions, on every state:

* Every nominal nonidentity operation decreases W by at least1. Identity
  attempts leave the entire W-relevant state unchanged.
* If W>0, at least one nominal operation is nonidentity/enabled.
* Each admitted supported fault increases W by at most C, with any
  replacement labels, including future-dependent choices.

It suffices to require these facts up to a stopping event, such as packet
delivery or a separately charged alteration of that packet. All additional
operations during the interval must leave the relevant state/potential
unchanged, or satisfy the same decrease condition. Later FIFO inputs obey
this for a chosen packet's prefix.

Fix analysis-window width w with m exp(-r_min w)<=1/16. For independent
fault support streams of total rate Lambda, let F_j be fault counts and
J_j the event of failed nominal clock coverage. The PATHWISE inequality

    W_(j+1)<=(W_j-1)^+ +(C+1)F_j+J_j

holds for every starting state and every fault labelling. Why coverage
works must be checked, not assumed: without a fault, either an earlier
nonidentity event already lowered W, or the unchanged initial state still
has its enabled action when that clock rings. Nominal state changes at
zero W-cost could invalidate this reasoning.

If Lambda w<=1/[16(C+1)], put z=1+1/(C+1) and
r=5/[16(C+1)]. The dominating Lindley queue begun at DETERMINISTIC Wmax
then satisfies

    E exp(r tau)<=z^Wmax,
    E tau<=8Wmax/7,
    Pr(tau>k)<=exp{[Wmax-5k/16]/(C+1)}.

These are a genuine recovery-time tail under continuing noise. Starting
at worst-case Wmax makes the good-schedule event simultaneous over all
controller states. Fixed-window unions pay future-selected activation
times; Finner/read-q pays several independent-clock cells coupled by
q-site fault support streams. PROOF.md contains the complete calculations.

# Root whole review: bounded-effect noisy asynchronous FIFO

29 October2026. ACCEPTED at the specified finite-bit/atomic-channel model.
PROOF.md SHA2564f6b081b4c9c2e91336fbdf2c0c4dfc42af9b27f113fd2096adcb1b3d12c59f5.
COVERAGE_ERODER.md SHA256155ffde677aa61a39088f716b916673dfb61886e124b78c5f1218d215ae2ad69.
I whole-read/reconstructed both, PRIOR_AND_DECISION, RESULT, fifo.py and
compile_deadline.py. No producer bytes were edited and no consumer rerun.

Every tag pattern is a valid bounded FIFO occupancy. I reconstructed all
local tag-flip cases, the queue-word invariant and the<=2q packet-edit
effect of a q-bit replacement. Input append and output pop preserve the
concatenated word relation; subsequent nominal stages do not amplify an
earlier edit. The local overwrite/commit guards supply causal release
without a global mathematical majority or fixed source-holding interval.

The all-state coverage argument is pathwise. In a fault-free covered
window, either a nonidentity action already lowered workload or the
unchanged relevant state retains an enabled clock until it rings. The
Lindley majorant from deterministic Wmax therefore avoids an anticipative
starting-pattern drift assumption. I reconstructed its mgf constant,
optional-stopping exponential/mean bounds and rational deadline compiler.
The fixed-boundary union, not strong Markov at a future-selected time,
pays all acceptance times. For an undamaged accepted packet, later inputs
lie behind its FIFO prefix; the same rightmost-packet/service argument
applies. The alternative is deadline OR a charged edit, equivalently a
small event of late AND undamaged, not small probability of raw edits.

The literal transition program matches these guards and occupancies.
The exact deadline compiler pays its M-dependent noise, clock coverage,
future-start union and bit arithmetic. Producer's all1024-state and57344-
fault-case receipt is a separately scoped execution; this review did not
repeat it or turn it into an all-size proof.

Accepted: the bounded-local dynamic noisy FIFO, unlocated edit budget,
schedule-uniform drain-epoch and transfer deadline-or-edit theorem. The
Finner extension requires the stated private clocks/independent streams;
serial concatenation instead uses the single pathwise queue invariant.
